title.es: Oro de molienda libre con gravimetría

description.en: Free gold liberated in the grinding circuit is dense and malleable, so cyclones return it to the mill; a gravity unit on an underflow bleed recovers it before flotation takes the gold held in pyrite.
description.es: El oro libre liberado en la molienda es denso y maleable, por lo que los ciclones lo devuelven al molino; una unidad gravimétrica en una purga del underflow lo recupera antes de que la flotación tome el oro contenido en pirita.

question.en: How much gold does a gravity bleed capture from the circulating load?
question.es: ¿Cuánto oro captura una purga gravimétrica de la carga circulante?

provenance: authored scenario; parameters inside cited ranges; not plant-calibrated

sources.breakage: Moly-Cop Tools energy-specific selection (alpha0 0.0091 t/kWh, alpha1 0.651, alpha2 2.5, d_crit 6514 µm) and its documented alternative breakage set (beta0 0.4, beta1 0.65, beta2 4.02); dossier section 1.4.
sources.crusher: Whiten classification K1 0.5 to 0.95 CSS, K2 1.7 to 3.5 CSS, K3 about 2.3; dossier section 1.3.
sources.cyclone: Plitt geometry ratios typical of mineral-processing cyclones; sharpness and underflow density authored; dossier section 2.
sources.gravity: Gravity bleed of cyclone underflow and gold circulating load (Laplante and Staunton, AMIRA P420B); dossier section 4.
sources.flotation: k from bubble surface area flux (Gorain et al. 1997), Savassi entrainment, perfect-mixer banks; floatability and widths authored within Trahar (1981) size behaviour; dossier section 3.
sources.water: Process-water capacity per tonne of ore (pumping and thickener capacity), authored 5% above each case's nominal requirement; it is the water constraint of the operating-point optimizer.
sources.kpi: Each nominal KPI range carries its own source in kpi_sources: a published value or range where one was found, labelled authored where none was; they are plausibility gates, not predictions.

recovery_pct.en: Authored: no published range was found for this case type.
recovery_pct.es: De autor: no se encontró un rango publicado para este tipo de caso.

gravity_recovery_pct.en: Inside the gravity-recoverable gold content of 25 to 92% measured on 13 ores (Laplante and Staunton, AMIRA P420B), since a plant recovers only part of it; the 70% ceiling is authored.
gravity_recovery_pct.es: Dentro del contenido de oro recuperable por gravedad de 25 a 92% medido en 13 menas (Laplante y Staunton, AMIRA P420B), pues una planta recupera solo parte; el techo de 70% es de autor.
